implementation.name: original-v4-03-request-local-prefill-decode
implementation.scope: Original request-local schematic. Three input tiles and two decode passes illustrate ownership; tile counts are schematic, not tensor sizes or timing.
implementation.question: When does a sampled token acquire KV state?

purpose: Follow consumed inputs into one growing request-local KV cache, then release that cache before the next independent evaluation.
guard: Snapshots repeat one growing request cache; sampled output acquires KV only on consumption. No KV survives into an independent control evaluation.
